plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Engineering, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/engineering-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Engineering Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnote 6 on this page as 'See program recommendations or requirements' — the 1st-semester unspecified slot is modeled as a choice slot with that definition; see advisor. Unnamed 3-unit rows in the 3rd and 4th semesters carry no footnote and name no course; they are modeled as generic elective slots (see advisor). The published grid lists PHYS 180 & 180L as 3 combined units in the 2nd semester (reconciling to the published semester total of 14), while the program course list shows the same pair as 4 units; the plan follows the published schedule grid and splits them 2+1 — confirm with advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
